supersedes_only: Undefined QCRD feature formulas in night10a_qcrd_candidate_registry.json
Undefined QCRD mask recipe and loss weights in SpaLORA_Night10A_QCRD_Score_RnD_Taskbook_2026-08-21.md
does_not_change: No ground-truth use in training or candidate construction
R1 and conditional R2 frontier policy

notation.z1_z2: Two authoritative frozen modality views in exact paired spot order, row-L2-normalized.
notation.zf: Authoritative frozen family reference fused view in the same order, row-L2-normalized.
notation.A: The authoritative existing sparse spatial graph for the exact unit, symmetrized by binary union with its transpose and with diagonal removed.
notation.p1_p2: Modality-specific frozen partitions computed or reused before QCRD training with the exact registered no-label H00 endpoint and exact registered K for that dataset.
notation.pf: Frozen family reference partition used only for output/reference parity and reporting.

zero_degree_rule.neighbor_mean: For a zero-degree spot, use its own row-normalized embedding as neighbor mean.
zero_degree_rule.audit: Record zero-degree spot count for every unit; do not fail or silently add edges.

frozen_modality_partitions.endpoint: Exact registered H00 implementation and K, with no labels passed to the transform process.
frozen_modality_partitions.rule: Reuse an exact historical p1/p2 partition when view SHA, graph SHA, seed, H00 config SHA and ordered spot SHA all match. Otherwise compute p1/p2 once before model initialization, lock them and hash them.
frozen_modality_partitions.selection_use: The partitions are unsupervised quality evidence only and may not be chosen or changed after label metrics are visible.

per_modality_features.formula: mean over degree-positive i of mean over j in N_A(i) of 1[pm_i == pm_j]; if no degree-positive spots, value=0

global_quality.pairwise_contrast: For each feature t: c_t=(e1_t-e2_t)/(abs(e1_t)+abs(e2_t)+eps), clipped to [-1,1].
global_quality.freeze: All raw features, contrasts and weights are computed before QCRDAdapter construction, persisted with SHA-256 and never recomputed during training.

per_spot_quality.neighbor_entropy: For each modality and spot, count modality-partition labels pm among spatial neighbors plus the spot itself. H_mi=-sum_c prob_c*log(prob_c)/log(min(K,degree_i+1)); define H_mi=0 when the denominator is 0.

reciprocal_mnn.implementation: blockwise or neighbor-index search only; no dense N-by-N matrix
reciprocal_mnn.support_1: number of reciprocal pairs whose first-view endpoint is i, divided by k and clipped to [0,1]
reciprocal_mnn.support_2: number of reciprocal pairs whose second-view endpoint is i, divided by k and clipped to [0,1]

per_spot_quality.freeze: All arrays are computed before model initialization, saved and hashed.

model.class: One QCRDAdapter class for both modality families; no dataset identifier argument or branch.
model.input: concat(student_input, stopgrad(teacher), stopgrad(zf), optional fixed Fourier coordinates)
model.initialization: Standard deterministic initialization for all layers except the final up-projection weight, which is initialized to exact zeros so epoch-0 correction is a no-op.
model.inference: No masking. Use clean student input and model.eval().

masking.masked_dimensions_per_spot: max(1,round_half_up(0.15*D)); cap at D-1 when D>1
masking.sampling: For every spot, sample exactly the registered number of distinct feature dimensions without replacement.
masking.seed: Little-endian uint64 from the first 8 bytes of SHA256('night10a-qcrd-mask-v1|'+candidate_id+'|'+input_artifact_sha256+'|'+scientific_seed+'|'+epoch).
masking.target: The clean, detached student mixture before masking.
masking.non_masked_candidates: Q01 and Q02 use clean student input and L_mask=0.
prohibitions: No dataset-name component in the mask seed
No re-sampling after seeing loss or metrics

losses.L_mask: For masked candidates: mean_i [sum_d M_id*(pred_student_id-clean_student_id)^2/(sum_d M_id*clean_student_id^2+eps)]; otherwise 0. pred_student is normalize(masked_student+corr).
losses.L_boundary: Over sparse spatial edges (i,j) with frozen pf_i != pf_j: mean relu(cos(zc_i,zc_j)-cos(zf_i,zf_j))^2; if no such edge, 0.
losses.L_mnn: Q07 only. Weighted mean over frozen reciprocal pairs (i,j) of 1-cos(z1c_i,z2c_j), with frozen edge weight sqrt((1-H_1i)*(1-H_2j))*(1-b_i)*(1-b_j); if total edge weight is 0, define 0.
forbidden: No data-dependent retuning of loss weights
No label metric in any loss
No omission of a registered nonzero term

fourier_coordinates_q06.standardization: Per coordinate dimension subtract mean and divide by max(std,1e-6).
fourier_coordinates_q06.features: Concatenate sin(freq*coord) and cos(freq*coord) for every frequency and coordinate dimension.

candidate_semantics.Q00_REFERENCE_ALIAS: Exact authoritative output alias. No model, optimizer, masking or transform recomputation unless needed only for hash/parity verification.
candidate_semantics.Q01_GLOBAL_QUALITY_BLEND: Global weights and global gate; clean input; common losses without L_mask or L_mnn.
candidate_semantics.Q02_SPOT_QUALITY_BLEND: Per-spot weights and base gate; clean input; common losses without L_mask or L_mnn.
candidate_semantics.Q03_MASKED_RESIDUAL: Global weights and global gate; deterministic 15% masking; common losses plus L_mask.
candidate_semantics.Q04_SPOT_GATED_MASKED_RESIDUAL: Per-spot weights and base gate; deterministic 15% masking; common losses plus L_mask.
candidate_semantics.Q05_BOUNDARY_GATED_RESIDUAL: Q04 with gate multiplied by 1-boundary_risk; same boundary loss weight.
candidate_semantics.Q06_COORDINATE_PRIOR_RESIDUAL: Q04 plus fixed Fourier coordinate features; no dense spatial kernel.
candidate_semantics.Q07_CONFIDENCE_MNN_RESIDUAL: Q04 plus frozen sparse confidence-weighted reciprocal-MNN loss at weight 0.10.

common_rules.self_tuning_affinity: Exact Night-6C implementation: Euclidean k=10 on row-L2-normalized embedding; sigma_i is distance to the 10th nonself neighbor; exp(-d2/(sigma_i*sigma_j)); maximum symmetrization; observation-id tie break.
common_rules.spectral: Exact Night-6C/Night-7B SPECTRAL_DISCRETIZE: precomputed sparse affinity, assign_labels='discretize', n_init=20, random_state=2020, exact registered K.

RNA+protein.source: Exact same-seed authoritative G04 private1/private2/fused views and spatial graph used by C00.
RNA+protein.candidate_endpoint: Run exact H05_EQUAL3_AFFINITY_SPECTRAL on corrected z1c, z2c and zc: arithmetic mean of their three sparse self-tuning affinities, followed by the fixed spectral partition.
RNA+protein.Q00_parity: Q00 must alias the historical C00 partition exactly and must not recompute it for reported reference metrics.

RNA+ATAC.source: Exact same-seed authoritative G04 private views, C06 equal-row-stochastic G00/G04 affinity, and F00/R02 fused adapter embedding/partition from Night-7B/Night-9B.
RNA+ATAC.reference_partition: Exact F00/R02 E1_ADAPTER_C06_MEAN/H01 partition for the registered seed.
RNA+ATAC.candidate_endpoint: Compute az=self_tuning_affinity(zc,k=10); compute affinity=sym_zero(0.5*row_sparse_strict(az)+0.5*row_sparse_strict(C06)); then run the exact fixed H01 SPECTRAL_DISCRETIZE partition.
RNA+ATAC.Q00_parity: Q00 must alias the historical F00/R02 partition exactly and must not recompute it for reported reference metrics.
RNA+ATAC.prohibition: Do not substitute C00, C01 or N02 as the P22 primary reference and do not rebuild G00/G04 or C06 by retraining.

fixed_output_endpoints.modality_quality_partitions: For p1/p2 only, apply the same common self-tuning affinity and fixed spectral endpoint independently to frozen z1 and z2 before QCRD model initialization. Lock and hash these partitions; they are not final candidate endpoints.

mandatory_semantic_tests: Five global feature values and exact global contrast/weight hand calculation on a tiny graph
Modality-specific neighbor entropy hand calculation including zero-degree spot
Spot logit, softmax weight, boundary risk and base gate hand calculation
Mask cardinality, determinism, epoch change and artifact-SHA change
All six loss components against an independent hand implementation
Each Q00-Q07 candidate activates exactly its registered gate, mask, coordinates and MNN terms
Teacher stop-gradient and frozen quality arrays
No dataset-name routing and identical trainable architecture across modality families
Sparse MNN and boundary losses without dense N-by-N allocation
Zero final up-projection gives exact epoch-0 no-op
RNA+protein Q00 exact C00 parity and candidate H05 endpoint semantics
P22 Q00 exact F00/R02 parity and candidate E1_ADAPTER_C06_MEAN/H01 endpoint semantics
Negative tests fail if any registered quality feature or nonzero loss term is omitted

label_policy.selection: Only after all registered outputs in a stage are locked. Core datasets are development evidence and must not be described as pristine holdouts.
